text: MERSQL01 started as a server nobody was watching and finished with a documented architecture, real security, real maintenance, a resolved incident, and a change-management process. That arc is this whole course, compressed into one scenario.

Twelve chapters, applied all at once to one real, specific server — sa everywhere and no log backups on one side, separated storage, a least-privilege login, and scheduled maintenance jobs on the other.

This is the third and final course in the Job Ready stage of the SQL Server Database Administrator path, after T-SQL Development and T-SQL for Database Administrators. Finishing it closes that stage entirely.

The five-beat structure from the last lesson — inherited state, fixes, incident, change, measurable improvement — is exactly the shape worth writing up as a real portfolio piece, because every number in it is something you can defend in detail.
Next up, opening the Advanced SQL Server stage: SQL Server Performance Tuning — making a server that's healthy, secure, and maintained also fast.
